description_short: Example pack showcasing add_unit_prefab: canned corn from empty cans + corn.
description_long: Example for the unit-product prefab API. Adds 'Empty cans' (made from iron, steel or aluminum in the basic Assembler) and 'Canned corn' (made from empty cans + corn in the Chemical Plant). Both unit products use the SAME prefab mesh, distinguished only by their albedo textures.
